blocks.text: ILIGAN CITY — The Iligan City government has allocated P5 million starting next year to support Indigenous Peoples’ culture and traditions. City Ordinance No. 26-7875 allocated the money to the Kaamulan Ta Bayug Iligan City Festival as a permanent platform for celebrating and preserving the cultural heritage of the city’s Indigenous communities. Bae Marecil Timbangan, a traditional female leader in Sitio Limunsudan, Barangay Rogongon, said the funding offers an opportunity to revive customs and practices that are gradually becoming unfamiliar to the youth.
